label: Weydub free subtitle removal
info:
Set WEYDUB_TRIAL_FILE to a local MP4 in a private folder. Deploy, open Debug, then click Upload only if authorized to send the file to Weydub. Full-frame Pro can erase labels and prices. Check status to download. Preserve the adjacent .weydub-receipt file.

[Setup and practice clip](https://github.com/JollyToday/GhostCut-auto_video_translation/tree/main/examples/node-red) | [Choose a smaller area in Weydub](https://weydub.com/subtitle-removal/).
